_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 49 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 124,070 berths as of December 31, 2017'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2017 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 49 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 124,070 berths as of December 31, 2017'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2017 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.37x; +36% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.37; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.3%/yr (Q3 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.2%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2018-09-21) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.37x (94.7% downside to Bear $7 / +40.0% upside to Bull $184) | Adj composite 2.61 vs market 2.24: gap +0.37 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +36% above the EPP floor $97 (11x FY18E $8.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: +13.6% total (+6.8%/yr) | At 14.9x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $174 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Net Yields +3.8% in Q2 2018, forward net revenue +10.36% (Q3 2018 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
